generation.comparison_note: These are formal template comparisons, not independent candidates or statistical experiments. Some prior histories have identical RNG effect; maxima are heavily selected and cannot be treated as leakage.

old_conclusion_correction.old: Packaging time only reflects sequential generation in anonymous numeric order
old_conclusion_correction.corrected: ZIP and UT modification-time buckets are interleaved throughout anonymous numeric order for both Query and Gallery; not monotonic. Public package times cannot be treated as acquisition times. Finite attempts to recover a sorted-write permutation found no exact fingerprint.

packaging_relation.conclusion: No useful identity or source-correspondence enrichment in package modification-time buckets. Visual query assignment 77/119 equals random expectation; known pixel copies also do not enrich. Do not use write-time buckets as identity gates.
packaging_relation.scope: Public package filesystem timestamps only; not acquisition metadata, not hidden labels. Exact query/galleries source copies are verified pixels; other matches are model guesses.

generation.strongest_remaining_hypothesis: 900 latent identities, one SAR Gallery and one optical Gallery per identity; 27 additional optical observations become O2O and O2S Query, with 93 additional query identities. This is compatible with file counts but not established by pixels.
generation.hypothesis_limit: Extra optical observations can include multiple images of the same latent identity. Gallery exact pixel duplicates can be same identity observations or different-identity label conflicts; public files do not resolve this.

exact-crop-summary.json.scope: All images, no hidden identity labels; exact RGB crop after support threshold bbox and D4; discarded exterior not matched

partial-crop-min1-summary.json.scope: All public and training images; axis-aligned exact local RGB texture only, no hidden test labels
partial-crop-min1-summary.json.limitations: Only translations aligned to 16-pixel grid and exact pixels; no proof of identity, no exclusion of interpolation/exposure overlap

alias-closure.json.scope: transitive strict source similarity then public training correspondence only, not hidden identities
alias-closure.json.caution: Source aliases contradict published IDs and never prove test identity. No output predictions or label assignments.

registration-summary.json.scope: Fixed image registration and predetermined fusion weights, same previously model-selected holdout; no hidden labels
registration-summary.json.candidate_pool: union top5 native/foreground/fullgray, two best coarse D4 transforms

oracle_definitions.bridge: Keep original Query pairing; replace missing optical query's inferred Gallery target with its own real same-ID optical Gallery observation chosen by best optical similarity; O2O unchanged. This is not an upper bound for all S2O target corrections because originally wrong Query pairs remain wrong.
oracle_definitions.pair: Use labelled correct Query one-to-one pairing, retain original optical target bridge and O2O rankings.
oracle_definitions.pair_and_bridge: Both above oracle changes, O2O unchanged. Diagnostic only, never a submitted algorithm.

limitations: All simulations reuse the same 703 validation identities already involved in model selection; seed0-19 and20-39 resample queries, not independent identities.
Native local and joint cloud caches are two checkpoints, not independent validation datasets.
Public ambiguity statistics use no hidden labels and do not estimate public accuracy or prove identity overlap.
Two-cycle/unused-column replacement loss is a label-free feasible alternative loss, not exact global edge-forbidding regret or calibrated identity confidence.
No proposed single-model control shows a large enough conditional net gain to explain a 0.67-to-0.9 jump.
Initial 8-seed outputs are screening snapshots; authoritative summaries are 40-seed outputs.
